```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(dplyr)
library(janitor)
library(ggpubr)
```

Creating dataframe
```{r}
df_enzyme_data <- read_csv("../DATA/enzyme_data.csv")
```

cleaning names
```{r}
df_enzyme_data <- df_enzyme_data %>%
  clean_names()

str(df_enzyme_data)
```

converting predictors to factors
```{r}
df_enzyme_data <- df_enzyme_data %>%
  mutate(across(c(acclimation_temperature_c,
                  acclimation_salinity_ppt,
                  test_temperature_c),
                as.factor))
```

CS
```{r}
CS <- ggplot(
  df_enzyme_data,
  aes(
    x = test_temperature_c,
    y = maximal_cs_activity_umol_min_mg_protein,
    color = acclimation_temperature_c
  )
) +
  
  # Mean points
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.3),
    size = 3
  ) +
  
  # Error bars (SE)
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "errorbar",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.3),
    width = 0.15
  ) +
  
  # Raw data
  geom_jitter(
    aes(fill = acclimation_temperature_c),
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      dodge.width = 0.3,
      jitter.width = 0.15
    ),
    alpha = 0.7,
    size = 2,
    shape = 21
  ) +
  
  # Match your color palette
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "10" = "#6BAED6",
      "24" = "#FB6A4A"
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "10" = "black",
      "24" = "black"
    )
  ) +
  
  # Facets (same as your boxplot)
  facet_wrap(
    ~ acclimation_salinity_ppt,
    labeller = labeller(
      acclimation_salinity_ppt = c(
        "11" = "Isosmotic (11 ppt)",
        "28" = "Brackish (28 ppt)"
      )
    )
  ) +
  
  # Theme aligned with your original
  theme_bw() +
  
  labs(
    x = "Test Temperature (°C)",
    y = "Maximal Activity (µmol/min/mg protein))",
    color = "Acclimation Temperature (°C)",
    fill = "Acclimation Temperature (°C)"
  ) +
  
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 1.2),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.2, "cm"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.8),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box.just = "right")
  )

plot(CS)
```

Saving photo
```{r}
ggsave(
  filename = "CS.png",
  plot = CS,
  width = 8,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 300
)
```

Combined CS/LDH/COX figure (shared y-axis, single legend)
```{r}
# Strip the individual y-axis titles (and legends) from each plot so they
# don't repeat in the combined figure - a shared axis label is added after.
CS_combo <- CS + labs(y = NULL)
LDH_combo <- LDH + labs(y = NULL)
COX_combo  <- COX  + labs(y = NULL)

combined_enzyme <- ggarrange(
  LDH_combo, CS_combo, COX_combo,
  ncol = 3,
  nrow = 1,
  common.legend = TRUE,
  legend = "bottom",
  labels = c("A", "B", "C")
)

combined_enzyme <- annotate_figure(
  combined_enzyme,
  left = text_grob(
    "Maximal Enzyme Activity (µmol/min/mg protein)",
    rot = 90,
    size = 14
  )
)

plot(combined_enzyme)
```

Saving combined figure
```{r}
ggsave(
  filename = "Combined_Enzyme.png",
  plot = combined_enzyme,
  width = 12,
  height =6,
  dpi = 300
)
```
